bindgen_input.observation: Bindgen emits the ordinary union in fixed parameter signatures for this input. Toucan projects supported GNU/Clang carriers while Microsoft signatures retain union passing; source-level Rust parameter types can therefore differ.

limits: Native execution here used x86_64 Linux. The same native test covers Linux AArch64 and macOS in CI; those executions are not claimed by this report.

Intel macOS Clang over-aligned union native calls are wired in the test and await native CI. AArch64 expanded-padding ABI is diagnosed. Windows uses ordinary union passing; its ABI evidence here is cross-target Clang LLVM plus target-profile generation.
Miri covers only Rust argument/storage validity and deliberately invalid negative controls; it does not execute C FFI.
The C frontend retains original union types and source-field conversions; this layer exposes emitted Rust ABI carrier types to callers.
